paper.title: Absolute Zero: Reinforced Self-play Reasoning with Zero Data
paper.central_claim: Absolute Zero 范式：单一模型提出可验证的代码推理任务并自我求解，仅用代码执行器反馈、不用任何外部数据，通过 RL 提升推理能力。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: Both task proposal and problem solving are trained using reinforcement learning.
evidence.support_explanation: 更新的proposer/solver为同一参数化LLM；不是保留非权重harness。
实验优化模型权重，输出训练后AZR模型。

evidence.quote: regardless if it gets any task reward
evidence.support_explanation: 有效triplet加入训练buffer，不代表其作为改进harness在独立部署评估。

evidence.quote: we prompt it using the current learner and train only the solver
evidence.support_explanation: 消融固定proposer依然以solver训练后能力为终点。

evidence.quote: in our final experiments, we choose not to remove globally declared variables
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认生成数据的答案泄漏选择；未转换为非权重组件效果主张。

evidence.quote: a single model learns to propose tasks that maximize its own learning progress and improves reasoning by solving them, without relying on any external data.
evidence.support_explanation: 单一模型兼任出题者与解题者，自生成任务并自训练

evidence.quote: The model is trained jointly with both roles, learning to create tasks that push the boundary of reasoning capacity while enhancing its ability to solve them effectively
We train the entire system end-to-end with a newly proposed reinforcement learning advantage estimator tailored to the multitask nature of the proposed approach.
use Task Relative REINFORCE++ to update
evidence.support_explanation: RL 更新的对象是模型参数 π_θ

evidence.quote: Finally, the Absolute Zero Reasoner is jointly updated using both
evidence.support_explanation: 最终联合更新 proposer 与 solver 角色(同一权重)

evidence.quote: To initialize AZR self-play, we first generate a seed set of valid triplets using the base language model.
evidence.support_explanation: 任务缓冲区(triplet buffer)是训练数据，随训练增长

evidence.quote: No model updates occur during the seeding phase.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅播种阶段不更新模型，其余阶段更新权重

evidence.quote: RL update: use Task Relative REINFORCE++ to update
evidence.support_explanation: Both proposer and solver improvement is delivered through weight updates.

evidence.quote: be our parameterized language model, it is used to play two roles, proposer
evidence.support_explanation: Proposer and solver are the same parameterized model.

evidence.quote: For the main experiments, we train AZR models on Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-7B-Coder
evidence.support_explanation: The evaluated artifacts are trained model checkpoints.

signatures.object: 模型权重 π_θ(同时承担 proposer 与 solver)
signatures.information: 代码执行器作为环境，验证任务并给出可验证奖励；无外部数据
signatures.operation: 自生成代码推理任务(deduction/abduction/induction)→执行器验证→模型求解→r_propose=可学习性、r_solve=0/1→TRR++ 更新权重
signatures.output: 更新后的权重与增长的 (p,i,o) 任务缓冲区
signatures.selection_rule_data: r_propose 偏好中等难度；非法任务过滤
signatures.persistence: 权重(留存)；任务缓冲区是训练数据
signatures.later_use: 缓冲区样本作为 proposer 的 in-context 参考，解题阶段采样训练
signatures.claimed_effect: 零外部数据下的编码/数学 SOTA(作者报告)

gap.author_gap: RLVR 仍依赖人工整理的问题-答案集，扩展性与超人类场景受限
